items.title: Customizable widgets for project cards
items.summary: The  in the dashboard now lets you choose which metric appears on each project card. Overview tabProject cards used to show a fixed Real Experience Score in the top right, but not everyone on your team watches the same signal. You can now swap that slot for whichever metric matters for that project. A security-sensitive project can show firewall activity, while a marketing site project shows traffic.Open the switcher in the top right of any project card. The menu shows the current value for each available metric. When you select one, your choice is saved for that project and follows your account across refreshes and devices.If a project does not have a feature enabled, you can start the enable flow from the widget menu without leaving the Overview tab. This is available for Speed Insights Plus, Web Analytics, and alerts.
